newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Banc One rating raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Banc One rating raised.

text.p: -- Natwest Markets has raised its rating on Banc One Corp to buy from trading buy.
-- Natwest analyst Tom McCandless cited an upbeat analysts meeting on March 13-14 and the proposed acquisition of First USA Corp.
-- McCandless set a 1997 price objective at 50-52 and a 1998 objective at 60-62, based on earnings estimates of $3.35 per share in 1997 and $4.00 in 1998.
-- Shares in the Columbus, Ohio-based financial services company traded at 43-3/8 on Monday, down 1-1/4.
